The '''cantina''' was a popular establishment in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Nashal]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].

==Description==
[[File:Nashal_cantina_interior.jpg|thumb|left|Inside the smoke-filled cantina.]]
The [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] was situated only few [[Meter/Legends|meters]] from the banks of the [[Mephyt River]], not far from the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. It had two entrances, one in the front and one in the back. The cantina consisted of a large room with a long, U-shaped bar counter in the middle of the room where a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] sold beverages. Six large booths along the walls provided tables and chairs where people could sit down, drink and listen to the [[Music/Legends|music]]. A door behind the bar led to a small back room that wasn't in use as of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Another room in the back of the cantina gave special patrons a little privacy from the other patrons' prying [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].

Among the beverages available at the bar were [[Adumari beer]], [[Lopez Softdrink]], [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|Ardees Beverage tea]], [[Milk/Legends|milk]] and imported [[Utozz]].

==Employees and patrons==
A bartender and the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Oecax]] worked in this cantina.

Among the beings who visited this cantina regularly in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] were the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Sigrix Slix]] and the [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] [[Green Laser]]. The [[Durge#Legacy|revived Durge]] temporarily hid in the back room of the cantina.

==Behind the scenes==
This cantina is a location in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Various NPCs can be found here that players have to talk to during quests. It also provides a place for players of the [[:w:c:swg:Entertainer|entertainer profession]] to perform their music and dancing acts and give out buffs.
